evals.name: drop-new-files
evals.prompt: i just dropped 3 new markdown files into my work-knowledge folder, can you sync them so they show up in tomorrow's briefing?
evals.expected_output: Skill runs sync_folder.py against the configured WORK_INTEL_HOME, summary reports 3 new files in folder labeled 'work-knowledge', offsets.json post-state contains 3 entries, ChromaDB documents collection has chunks for all 3 files.
evals.fixture_pre_state: WORK_INTEL_HOME has empty offsets.json. Watched folder contains 3 .md files (auth-migration-plan, q3-okrs, slo-review).

evals.name: scoped-by-label
evals.prompt: sync just my research folder please, the work-knowledge stuff hasn't changed
evals.expected_output: Skill detects that user wants only the 'research' label, runs sync_folder.py with --label research, summary reports 1 new file in research folder only, work-folder is left untouched in offsets.
evals.fixture_pre_state: WORK_INTEL_HOME has empty offsets.json. Two watches configured: 'work-knowledge' (1 .md file) and 'research' (1 .md file).

evals.name: deletion-cleanup
evals.prompt: I removed an obsolete mongo runbook from my knowledge folder yesterday — please clean up the index so it stops surfacing in searches
evals.expected_output: Skill runs sync_folder.py, summary reports 1 deleted file (the missing mongo runbook), 2 unchanged files. Post-state offsets.json has 2 entries (the missing one is dropped).
evals.fixture_pre_state: WORK_INTEL_HOME has offsets.json with 3 entries. Watched folder has only 2 of those 3 files on disk (old-runbook-mongo.md was deleted).

evals.name: no-op-already-synced
evals.expected_output: Skill runs sync_folder.py, summary reports 0 new, 0 modified, 0 deleted, all files unchanged. User-facing message tells them nothing changed.
evals.fixture_pre_state: WORK_INTEL_HOME has offsets.json that exactly matches the 2 .md files on disk (mtime + size identical).
